purpose: Distinguish actors and broad body regions for pose reading; not a clinical muscle atlas.
region_assignment: Dominant deformation-region weights aggregated per disconnected mannequin piece, with small upper-arm shoulder pieces classified as shoulders; identical face mapping for A and B.

modes.regions: Actor palette with stable region shades

rules: Never swap actor palettes between poses.
Do not use rainbow anatomy colors that erase actor identity.
Use the same semantic region map across body profiles.
Color changes must not alter geometry, pose, measurements, or rig controls.
Record visual profile version, actor palette IDs, appearance mode, and slider values in output metadata.
enforcement: Required metadata and QA checks for future production; this proposal is not yet applied to the main pair template.
